fields.Title: Antec Outside Gaming PC
fields.Description: Tower PC. ASUS A7V Motherboard with AMD Athlon CPU, 2x256MB RAM. With Creative Labs GB0010, Creative Sound Blaster Liver! SB0060 sound card, 10/100 NIC, Wifi card, USB headers, 3x IDE hard drives, Yamaha CD-RW drive, 3.5" FD, and Creative Live! Driver IR for the sound card. Also has serial 3 button mouse and CD taped to the top.
